skills.name: Direct numerator subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract numerators when fractions share a common denominator, keeping the denominator unchanged.

skills.name: LCD conversion
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator of two unlike fractions and convert both to equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Whole-part subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number parts of two mixed numbers (or a whole number treated as whole+0/d) independently from the fractional parts.

skills.name: Borrowing/regrouping
skills.definition: When the fractional subtraction would be negative, borrow 1 from the whole part (rewritten as d/d) and redo the fraction subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify to lowest terms
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction result to its lowest-terms equivalent by dividing numerator and denominator by their GCD.

skills.name: Normalize improper fractional part
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number whose fractional part is improper (numerator ≥ denominator) into a proper mixed number before performing whole/fraction subtraction.
